definitions.short: a memento (or memorable thing, day or writing)
definitions.full: H2146. zikkaron זִכָּרֹן זִכָּרוֺן, noun masculine Eccl 1:11 memorial, remembrance (compare Lg BN 199, 200 ) — absolute זִכָּרוֺן Josh 4:7 +; זִכָּרֹן Exod 28:12 (twice in verse); 28:29 ; construct זִכְרוֺן Eccl 1:11 2 t.; suffix זִכְרוֺנֵךְ Isa 57:8 ; plural הַזִּכְרֹנוֺת Est 6:1 ; suffix זִכְרֹנֵיכֶם Job 13:12 ; — 1 memorial, reminder: a. memorial-day Exod 12:14 (P). b. memorial-usage Exod 13:9 (JE). c. memorial-objects, altar-plates Num 17:5 (P); stones in Jordan Josh 4:7 (JE); crowns in temple Zech 6:14 ; ׳ז in Isa 57:8 is symbol of strange god (Di), or perhaps phallus-image, as sign of harlot (Che), compare > Du (who proposes זְכָרוֺן , from זָכָר ). d. memorial-record ; in a book Exod 17:14 (E); compare זִכָּרוֺן סֵפֶר Mal 3:16 , ׳ס הימים דברי הַזִּכְרֹנות Est 6:1 ; memorial, as proof of citizenship Neh 2:20 (|| צְדָקָה חֵלֶק, ); reminder of Israel, י ׳לִפְנֵי , of הַכִּמֻּרִים כֶּסֶף Exod 30:16 ; spoils of war Num 31:54 ; inscribed stones of ephod Exod 28:12 , 29 , called ז ׳אַבְנֵי 28:12 = 39:7 ; blowing of trumpets Num 10:10 (foregoing all P), compare תְּרוּעַה זִכְרוֺן Lev 23:24 (H; where, however, no י ׳לפני , see Di); (ה)זכרון מִנְחַת Num 5:15 , 18 (P); memorial-sentence, apophthegm Job 13:12 . ** אֵפֶר מִשְׁלֵיֿ זִכְרֹנֵיכֶם 13:12 your memorial words are ashen sayings (i.e. worthless), compare Bu Du; Margolis (privately) suggests that ᵐ5 seems to have read לְאֵפֶר יִמָּשֵׁל [? < רָנְּכֶם ] רָנְיְכֶם your exultation shall be like ashes. 2 remembrance Eccl 1:11 (construct before preposition Ges § 130 , 1), 1:11 ; 2:16 .
